messages:
jordan: Quick check — PR #3022 is green except golangci-lint is failing on an initialism naming nit. I accidentally used `Uuid` while wiring up session serialization.

jordan: offending snippet:
```
type Session struct {
    Uuid string `json:"uuid,omitempty"`
}
```
Should I rename the field to `UUID` (exported) and keep the `json:"uuid"` tag, or is it better to keep the current name and add an exception somewhere?

tess: Rename to `UUID` please. Go conventions want common initialisms uppercased (UUID, HTTP, ID). The tag staying `json:"uuid"` is correct so the JSON stays unchanged.

lee: +1. Also check other structs in the pkg around sessions; we had a mixed `Uuid`/`UUID` history in a couple files. Might be worth a tiny sweep to keep things consistent.

ci-bot: CI failure: golangci-lint error in pkg/session/session.go: "exported name Uuid should have comment or be UUID". Full log: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/3022/logs

jordan: ok will push a small follow-up that renames `Uuid` -> `UUID`, keep tag as `json:\"uuid,omitempty\"`. I'll run `gofmt` and `golangci-lint run` locally first.

tess: if it's purely a rename + comment (no behavior change), mark the commit message `style: fix initialism` and note in the PR description that it's non-functional. Reviewers will re-approve faster.

lee: If you end up force-pushing, add a short note in the PR so approvals can be re-used. Also consider a quick `git grep -n "Uuid"` in the repo to catch similar cases.

jordan: pushed at 2634501300 — renamed to `UUID`, left `json:"uuid,omitempty"`, ran `gofmt` and `golangci-lint run`. Also ran `git grep -n \"\bUuid\b\"` and fixed two other occurrences in tests.

tess: skimmed the diff — looks purely stylistic. LGTM. I'll re-approve and merge when CI is green. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI succeeded: all checks passed for PR #3022.

merge-bot: Merged PR #3022 into main (merge method: squash).
